conclusion: hunts/higher_xi/C2_EXACT.json is the correct kappa=2 table: a fourth derivation written for this adjudication, importing neither disputant, reproduces its eleven values exactly while reproducing the published Farmer-Gonek kappa=1 row exactly as its control. hunts/rogue_frontier/fkappa/ is wrong from i=2 because it carried Bian's Lemma 12 constant C_kappa,2 = -4 as an axiom while auditing the code around it, whereas the x^1 coefficient of Qhat_kappa is kappa*g and therefore C_kappa,2 = -4*kappa.
confidence: High, and a human can lean on it. Three things carry it: exact rational arithmetic with no floating point and no precision parameter; an external anchor neither hunt owns (Farmer-Gonek arXiv:0803.0425, eleven values including four forced zeros, reproduced exactly by the same code path at kappa=1); and the losing side's own RESULTS.md section 1 stating in writing that it carried C_kappa,2 = -4 rather than deriving it, which makes the mechanism documentary rather than inferred. One honest limit: the probe borrows the basis pairing from higher_xi. That ingredient is kappa-independent by construction and is calibrated by the kappa=1 row, and fault_check.py shows the kappa=1 control does turn red under a one-factorial corruption of it, so the borrowing is anchored rather than circular. A fully independent rederivation of the pairing from the mean-value theorem was not attempted within budget.

core_candidates.what: an invariance control: when a claim asserts a quantity is invariant in a parameter, the control must vary that parameter, and its power must be measured by planting the defect rather than asserted
core_candidates.why_reusable: this is the second recorded instance of the same failure shape in this repository. Run 726a6b3f found finite_height_spacing_experiment sweeping ell only and holding effective gamma at 1, so it could not vary W at fixed x, which is exactly the quantity section 4 claims is W-independent. Here fkappa swept kappa = 1..9 throughout while the constant it had fixed sat upstream of everything it varied. Both are controls blind to their own subject, and in both cases the fix was two or three lines.
